outcome: Write and compile one real chapter locally: structured editor, PDFs and BibTeX/RIS import, anchored citations (quote or paraphrase) with hover and quote check, LaTeX/PDF with template, trace check, versions and backup, install
proof: an agent writes and exports a real chapter from CC-licensed sources and an independent judge panel reviews it (T23)

contracts.northstar: a direct quote is additionally checked verbatim
contracts.negative: The anchored direct quote altered by one character in the document is reported as not verbatim and the export is blocked.

contracts.northstar: Hovering a citation shows the anchored passage with its printed page
contracts.negative: A citation whose printed page is neither derived nor set by the user is reported and the export is blocked.

contracts.northstar: what is not anchored is listed, and a broken trace blocks the export
contracts.negative: A stale anchor after a changed extraction and a cited source whose existence check was not run are both reported and the export is blocked.

contracts.northstar: only a quote from a print-only source without a stored copy may pass, marked not checked, after a logged confirmation
contracts.negative: A quote from a print-only source without a stored copy and without a logged confirmation blocks the export.
A file named .pdf without the %PDF- header and a malformed BibTeX entry are rejected with a message and nothing enters the library.

contracts.northstar: generates LaTeX, PDF and docx through the university template
contracts.negative: An export requested while the trace check is red writes no PDF and no bundle and names the blocking findings.

contracts.northstar: docx only through Pandoc from the generated LaTeX
contracts.negative: With Pandoc not installed the docx route answers 503 pandoc-unavailable and starts no other process.

contracts.northstar: no automatic marker reaches the thesis
contracts.negative: A project whose metadata and change log carry a canary authorship marker exports a .tex and a PDF whose text and metadata do not contain the canary.

contracts.northstar: puts everything else on a wishlist with links into the author's own library (DOI, link resolver, catalogue, interlibrary loan), configurable for any library
contracts.negative: Building the wishlist links makes no network request, and an entry title holding a script tag is exported as text with no script element in the HTML.
The server killed with signal 9 in the middle of an editing session loses no acknowledged edit and the document opens after the restart.
Without any compile path (no Docker, no host TeX) the app names the missing compile path instead of failing silently and still produces the export bundle.
contracts.source: #100 AC12; NORTHSTAR who it is for

contracts.northstar: an agent writes and exports a real chapter from CC-licensed sources
contracts.negative: The same chapter with one anchored quote changed by one word is blocked from export.

contracts.northstar: an independent judge panel reviews it (T23)
contracts.operator: The judge panel (.claude/workflows/ar-judge.js with model fable) reviews the agent's exported chapter by the T23 checklist and records the verdict in the T23 ticket; the release panel (.claude/workflows/ar-release.js) repeats the check in docs/release/<version>.md.
